concerns.location: tasks.md:T005, T006, and 'Dependencies and requirement coverage' table (FR-010 row)
concerns.text: Tasks are tagged and the coverage table maps FR-010 ('feature importance', feature_importance.traditional/topological arrays, model_metrics.schema.yaml), but spec.md defines only FR-001…FR-009 — FR-010 does not exist in the spec. This is a stale/unauthorized requirement tag; either add FR-010 to spec.md (US-2 acceptance scenario 3 does ask for feature-importance reporting, so it is justifiable) or remove the FR-010 references from tasks.md and the coverage table.

The plan defines a dedicated script `00_checksum_verify.py` ('validates checksums; supports SC-004'), but no task creates or runs it. T001 only appends checksums to data/checksums.txt; nothing verifies them downstream. Either add a task for the checksum-verification script or fold its verification step into an existing task (e.g., T010's pipeline run) so the plan element is covered.
